name: get_custom_environment
description:
Get a project's custom environment by project ID or name and environment slug or ID. Custom environments are separate from the built-in Production and Preview environments.

CLI fallback on MCP failure (partial): vercel api /v9/projects/{idOrName}/custom-environments/{environmentSlugOrId} --method GET. Fill placeholders from inputs.

environmentSlugOrId.description: The unique custom environment identifier within the project

idOrName.description: The unique project identifier or the project name

slug.description: Team slug to use for this operation. Use instead of teamId.

teamId.description: Team ID to use for this operation.
